XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadic ignition of the injection warning light, poor acceleration
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: engine management | injection | B1003 | injection warning light | fault warning light | low performance | poor acceleration

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Make: Fiat
  • Model: 500 (150)
  • Engine: 1.2i 8V
  • Year: 2007
  • Engine code / VIN: 169 A 4000
  • System Marelli IAW 5SF8 CF5 injection

• Fault: Intermittent illumination of the injection warning light, poor acceleration

  • Fault code DTC: B1003, Phase variator

  • Cause: Phase variator failure

• Intervention: Replacement of the phase variator

  • Procedure: PHASE VARIATOR: to check the phase variator, disconnect the control solenoid valve, start the engine, connect a power supply (battery) to the terminals of the phase variator solenoid valve; you should hear a noticeable change in the idle speed.

  • Note: After resolving the fault, you must communicate with the control unit and clear the faults using special diagnostic equipment in the "ERRORS" environment.
